entities.name: Patron of the Akki
entities.description: Great patron kami of the akki, a giant stony serpent that became malevolent and devours the akki who sacrifice themselves to it.

entities.name: Akki
entities.description: Goblin-like folk who revere and fear the Patron.

entities.name: Ik-Uk
entities.description: A lowly scavenger akki who released a kami spirit from an ebon bottle.

entities.name: Fiery kami spirit
entities.description: Small kami shorn from the Patron, resembling a burning unborn akki.

entities.name: Kami War
entities.description: War in which the great spirits war on the living.

events.summary: Ik-Uk opens an ebon bottle and releases a small fiery kami that offers to serve him.
events.quote: he unknowingly released a small, fiery kami spirit

events.summary: Ik-Uk commands the spirit to protect him, leading to the deaths of other akki who threaten him.
events.quote: leading to the deaths of other akki who threatened him

events.summary: Ik-Uk explains that the Patron has become a malevolent force.
Ik-Uk is captured by akki at an ancient mountain and devoured whole by the Patron.
events.quote: The Patron, a terrifying and massive being, devoured Ik-Uk whole.

events.summary: Inside the Patron, the kami reveals it kept its promise by placing him in the safest place and that he will face a gruesome fate after a year and a day.
events.quote: after a year and a day, Ik-Uk would face a gruesome fate

relations.quote: It is the great Patron Kami of the Akki.

relations.note: a shard shorn from the Patron
relations.quote: the same entity from which the kami was originally shorn

relations.note: bound to serve him in exchange for freedom
relations.quote: offered to serve Ik-Uk in exchange for freeing it
